title: Oven Baked Slovakian Dough Flatbread
description: A traditional Slovakian flatbread recipe featuring red wine vinegar and a lacquer glaze, this dish is yeasty, chewy, and light, making it a great option for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the red wine vinegar, olive oil, sugar, and water.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough on a tava griddle or a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the lacquer glaze over the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until it is golden brown.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
